scope: Reviewed development labels, UTC calendar years 2001–2021 only

map_display.note: Simplified geometry is for display; original labels, area and grid membership are retained. County panels have separate scales.

county_assignment: Largest county area share of each original county-union-clipped cell; not exact incident county.
rate_denominator: Known reviewed labels. Flagged zeros retain label 0 and remain in this denominator, as in the frozen reviewed data.
flagged_zero_policy: Use the frozen 155-cell-year mask as an annotation only. No relabeling. ML evaluation excludes these rows; this historical rate includes them.
limits: Binary cell-year occupancy is not an incident count.
No recorded occurrence does not establish absence of fire.
Reporting variation and the 2020 source transition cannot be separated from real occurrence changes.
Variable cell areas and retrospective county attribution limit comparisons.
